import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
q=np.array([2.959877e-6,-1.047584,0.003174,-2.639955,-0.004409,1.535636,-2.319998])
target=np.array([0.0004411,-0.1702941,1.2118893])
quat=np.array([-0.01710565,-0.69415678,0.71925587,-0.02290739]) # wxyz
Rtarget=Rotation.from_quat([quat[1],quat[2],quat[3],quat[0]]).as_matrix()
def dh(a,alpha,d,theta):
 c,s=np.cos(theta),np.sin(theta); ca,sa=np.cos(alpha),np.sin(alpha)
 return np.array([[c,-s*ca,s*sa,a*c],[s,c*ca,-c*sa,a*s],[0,sa,ca,d],[0,0,0,1.]])
# common Panda DH parameters; report flange/TCP combinations
for variant in range(4):
 if variant==0: a=[0,0,0,.0825,-.0825,0,.088]; d=[.333,0,.316,0,.384,0,.107]; al=[0,-np.pi/2,np.pi/2,np.pi/2,-np.pi/2,np.pi/2,np.pi/2]
 if variant==1: a=[0,0,.0825,-.0825,0,.088,0]; d=[.333,0,.316,0,.384,0,.107]; al=[0,-np.pi/2,np.pi/2,np.pi/2,-np.pi/2,np.pi/2,np.pi/2]

 if variant==3: a=[0,0,.0825,-.0825,0,.088,0]; d=[.333,0,.316,0,.384,0,.107]; al=[0,np.pi/2,-np.pi/2,-np.pi/2,np.pi/2,-np.pi/2,np.pi/2]
 T=np.eye(4)
 for i in range(7): T=T@dh(a[i],al[i],d[i],q[i])

 print('R',np.round(T[:3,:3],3))

import limited_client as robot, numpy as np
from scipy import ndimage
print('STATUS',robot.status())
o=robot.observe(camera=2); r=o['robot']; rgb=o['rgb'].astype(int); K=o['intrinsic']; T=o['camera_to_world']
print('ROBOT',r)
pc=np.linalg.inv(T)@np.r_[r['tcp_position'],1.]; uv=K@pc[:3]; print('TCP pixel',uv[:2]/uv[2],'camera xyz',pc[:3])
# Brown mat mask: dark reddish surface; report substantial connected regions
mask=(rgb[:,:,0]>rgb[:,:,1]*1.15)&(rgb[:,:,0]>rgb[:,:,2]*1.25)&(rgb[:,:,0]<150)&(rgb[:,:,1]<100)
lab,n=ndimage.label(mask); comps=[]
for i,s in enumerate(ndimage.find_objects(lab),1):
 if s is None: continue
 area=int((lab[s]==i).sum())
 if area>100:
  yy,xx=np.where(lab[s]==i); yy+=s[0].start; xx+=s[1].start
  comps.append((area,(round(xx.mean(),1),round(yy.mean(),1)),(int(xx.min()),int(yy.min()),int(xx.max()),int(yy.max()))))
print('reddish components',sorted(comps,reverse=True)[:10])
for u,v in [(110,265),(150,260),(280,300),(360,300)]:
 z=float(np.median(o['depth_m'][v-2:v+3,u-2:u+3])); p=np.array([(u-K[0,2])*z/K[0,0],(v-K[1,2])*z/K[1,1],z,1]); print('pixel',u,v,'depth',round(z,3),'world',np.round((T@p)[:3],3))
print('STATUS',robot.status())
